measurement.method: external Monitoring System checks every 60 seconds from at least 3 locations; Unavailable when 2 consecutive checks from at least 2 locations fail to get a successful response within 30 seconds; Availability = ((Total Minutes - Excluded Minutes - Downtime) / (Total Minutes - Excluded Minutes)) x 100, rounded down to 2 decimals

A.claim_deadline: 30 days after end of the Measurement Period
A.credit_delivery: deduction from next invoice after confirmation; bank transfer within 30 days of confirmation if no further invoice because the Agreement has ended (not where Vendor terminated for Customer's breach)
